title: LibScript Component Scaffold Specification
description: Declarative specification for non-interactively generating a new LibScript Tier 1 component-package-manager directory under _lib/<category>/<component>/.

name.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the component directory and CLI command (e.g., ripgrep, fd, zoxide).

title.description: Human-readable display title for the component (defaults to name if omitted).

category.description: Target category directory under _lib/ where the component will be created.

description.description: Concise 1-2 sentence description of the component and its purpose.

items.description: Capability or command alias identifier provided by this component.

provides.description: List of capabilities or command aliases provided by this component (defaults to [name]).

conflicts.description: Other LibScript components that conflict with this component.

binary_name.description: Primary executable binary filename located inside the installed bin/ directory (defaults to name).

default_install_method.description: Default installation strategy ('libscript_native' for isolated version directories, 'system' for OS package manager, or 'from-source').

version_scheme.description: Upstream version discovery and resolution scheme used for 'latest'/'lts' aliases and 'ls-remote'.

default_version.description: Default version or alias to install when no explicit version is specified.

items.description: Supported semantic version alias (e.g., latest, lts, stable).

version_aliases.description: List of dynamic version aliases supported by the component version manager.

repository.description: Canonical upstream source repository URL (e.g., https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep).

github_repo.description: GitHub owner/repo identifier used for automatic GitHub Releases API tag resolution.

tag_prefix.description: Prefix stripped from upstream release tags when normalizing version numbers (e.g., 'v' or 'jq-').

download_url_template_unix.description: Default artifact download URL or template for POSIX platforms (Linux, macOS, BSD).

download_url_template_windows.description: Default artifact download URL or template for Windows platforms.

releases_url.description: Upstream API or index URL queried by the 'ls-remote' lifecycle action.

archive_format_unix.description: Expected archive or binary format for Unix downloads ('auto' inspects URL/filename extension).

archive_format_windows.description: Expected archive or installer format for Windows downloads ('auto' inspects URL/filename extension).

strip_components.description: Number of leading path components to strip when extracting tarballs.

source_build.description: Configuration for compiling the component from source when INSTALL_METHOD='from-source'.

language.description: Primary language toolchain required to build from source (e.g., c, rust, go).

build_system.description: Build system driver passed to libscript_build_component_from_source (e.g., autotools, cmake, cargo, make).

fallback_version.description: Concrete fallback version string used when building 'latest' from source without network tag resolution.

source_url_template.description: Optional explicit source tarball URL template overriding the binary download URL.

items.description: Canonical operating system identifier supported by this component.

os_whitelist.description: List of operating systems supported by this component.

items.description: Canonical operating system identifier explicitly unsupported by this component.

os_blacklist.description: List of operating systems explicitly unsupported by this component.

items.description: Supported CPU architecture identifier (e.g., all, x86_64, aarch64, arm64, riscv64).

arch_whitelist.description: List of CPU architectures supported by this component.

arch_blacklist.description: List of CPU architectures explicitly unsupported by this component.

items.description: Target OS family for generating dedicated setup_<os>.sh and setup_<os>.cmd scripts.

os_specific_scripts.description: Optional list of OS families for which dedicated setup_<os>.{sh,cmd} scripts should be generated.

is_service.description: Whether this component operates as a background daemon or persistent service.

ports.description: Default network listening ports exposed by the service.

enable_hooks.description: Whether to generate Dual-Layer physical instance lifecycle hooks in hooks/*.{sh,cmd}.

multitenant.description: Whether the component supports logical multi-tenant provisioning hooks (provision_tenant, deprovision_tenant, backup_tenant, restore_tenant).

custom_vars.description: Additional component-specific configuration variables to include in vars.schema.json.

items.description: Definition of a custom component configuration variable.

type.description: JSON Schema data type for the variable (string, integer, boolean).

default.description: Default value for the configuration variable.

description.description: Human-readable description of the configuration variable.

pkg_mappings.description: Optional mapping of OS package manager identifiers (apt-get, apk, dnf, pacman, brew, winget, choco, scoop, pkg) to native package names.

apt-get.description: Package name on Debian/Ubuntu apt-get repositories.

apk.description: Package name on Alpine Linux apk repositories.

dnf.description: Package name on RHEL/Fedora dnf/yum repositories.

pacman.description: Package name on Arch Linux pacman repositories.

zypper.description: Package name on openSUSE/SLES zypper repositories.

brew.description: Formula or tap name on Homebrew.

winget.description: Package identifier on Windows Package Manager (winget).

test_command.description: Smoke test command executed in test.sh and test.cmd (defaults to '<binary_name> --version').
